   - Check what columns exist in pingtung_wells.csv, pingtung_training.csv, and pingtung_estimation_grid.csv

2. In the workflow notebook (examples/pingtung_lithology/pingtung_lithology_workflow.ipynb), find:

   - How loocv_categorical handles xgb_prior_fn

3. In the nonstationary notebook (examples/pingtung_lithology/pingtung_lithology_nonstationary.ipynb), check:
   - The estimation cell structure
   - How loocv is done

            "lineNumber": 1021,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": ") -&gt; Union[np.ndarray, Tuple[np.ndarray, Dict[str, Any]]]:",
            "lineNumber": 1022,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"Estimate categorical prior PDFs for use in :func:&#96;BMEcatPdf&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 1023
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1024
          },
          {
            "text": "    Trains a machine-learning model on categorical hard data at known",
            "lineNumber": 1025
          },
          {
            "text": "    locations (&#96;&#96;cs&#96;&#96;, &#96;&#96;ps&#96;&#96;) and predicts class probabilities at",
            "lineNumber": 1026
          },
          {
            "text": "    estimation locations (&#96;&#96;ck&#96;&#96;).  The returned matrix can be passed",
            "lineNumber": 1027
          },
          {
            "text": "    directly to :func:&#96;BMEcatPdf&#96; via its &#96;&#96;external_priors&#96;&#96; argument.",
            "lineNumber": 1028
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1029
          },
          {
            "text": "    Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 1030
          },
          {
            "text": "    ----------",
            "lineNumber": 1031
          },
          {
            "text": "    ck : np.ndarray, shape (nk, nd)",
            "lineNumber": 1032
          },
          {
            "text": "        Estimation coordinates (rows = locations, columns = spatial dims).",
            "lineNumber": 1033
          },
          {
            "text": "    cs : np.ndarray, shape (ns, nd)",
            "lineNumber": 1034
          },
          {
            "text": "        Hard-data coordinates.",
            "lineNumber": 1035
          },
          {
            "text": "    ps : np.ndarray, shape (ns,) or (ns, nc)",
            "lineNumber": 1036
          },
          {
            "text": "        Hard-data observations.  Either a 1-D array of integer category",
            "lineNumber": 1037
          },
          {
            "text": "        codes, or a 2-D one-hot / probability matrix.",
            "lineNumber": 1038
          },
          {
            "text": "    ck_features : np.ndarray, shape (nk, nf), optional",
            "lineNumber": 1039
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ancillary feature matrix at estimation locations.  Falls back to",
            "lineNumber": 1040
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;ck&#96;&#96; (spatial coordinates only) when &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 1041
          },
          {
            "text": "    cs_features : np.ndarray, shape (ns, nf), optional",
            "lineNumber": 1042
          },
          {
            "text": "        Ancillary feature matrix at training locations.  Falls back to",
            "lineNumber": 1043
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;cs&#96;&#96; when &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 1044
          },
          {
            "text": "    station_ids : sequence, shape (ns,), optional",
            "lineNumber": 1045
          },
          {
            "text": "        Well / station identifiers.  Used to form grouped CV splits so",
            "lineNumber": 1046
          },
          {
            "text": "        depth samples from the same borehole never cross the",
            "lineNumber": 1047
          },
          {
            "text": "        train/test boundary.",
            "lineNumber": 1048
          },
          {
            "text": "    method : {\"xgboostlss\", \"xgboost\", \"uniform\"}, optional",
            "lineNumber": 1049
          },
          {
            "text": "        Prior estimation method (default &#96;&#96;\"xgboostlss\"&#96;&#96;).",
            "lineNumber": 1050
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1051
          },
          {
            "text": "        * &#96;&#96;\"xgboostlss\"&#96;&#96; — Dirichlet-output gradient boosting via",
            "lineNumber": 1052
          },
          {
            "text": "          :mod:&#96;xgboostlss&#96;.  Tuned with native Optuna interface.",
            "lineNumber": 1053
          },
          {
            "text": "        * &#96;&#96;\"xgboost\"&#96;&#96; — Softmax gradient boosting via",
            "lineNumber": 1054
          },
          {
            "text": "          :class:&#96;xgboost.XGBClassifier&#96;.  Tuned via :mod:&#96;spotpy&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 1055
          },
          {
            "text": "        * &#96;&#96;\"uniform\"&#96;&#96; — Flat &#96;&#96;1/nc&#96;&#96; prior (no model, no features).",
            "lineNumber": 1056
          },
          {
            "text": "    hyperparams : dict, optional",
            "lineNumber": 1057
          },
          {
            "text": "        Fixed model hyperparameters.  When provided, **no tuning** is",
            "lineNumber": 1058
          },
          {
            "text": "        performed.",
            "lineNumber": 1059
          },
          {
            "text": "    cv_config : dict, optional",

          },
          {
            "text": "        Cross-validation / tuning configuration.  Merged with",
            "lineNumber": 1061
          },
          {
            "text": "        :data:&#96;DEFAULT_CV_CONFIG&#96;.  Key entries:",
            "lineNumber": 1062
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1063
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;n_trials&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 1064
          },
          {
            "text": "            Number of tuning trials (set to &#96;&#96;0&#96;&#96; to skip tuning).",

          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;optimization_method&#96;&#96;",

          },
          {
            "text": "            Algorithm for XGBoost spotpy tuning",

          },

            "lineNumber": 1068

          },

          },

          },

          {
            "text": "    return_details : bool, optional",
            "lineNumber": 1082
          },
          {
            "text": "        When &#96;&#96;True&#96;&#96; returns a tuple &#96;&#96;(prior_matrix, details)&#96;&#96; where",

          },

            "lineNumber": 1087
          },
          {
            "text": "    Returns",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 1089
          },
          {
            "text": "    prior_matrix : np.ndarray, shape (nk, nc)",

          {
            "lineNumber": 1102
          },

          {
            "text": "#!/usr/bin/env python3",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "\"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "Prior PDF estimation utilities for categorical BME workflows.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;BMEcatPrior&#96; mirrors the coordinate-based interface of &#96;BMEcatPdf&#96;: it",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "accepts estimation coordinates (&#96;&#96;ck&#96;&#96;), hard-data coordinates (&#96;&#96;cs&#96;&#96;), and",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "hard-data observations (&#96;&#96;ps&#96;&#96;). Feature matrices for machine-learning",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "priors can be passed separately via &#96;&#96;ck_features&#96;&#96; and &#96;&#96;cs_features&#96;&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "Two machine-learning backends are provided:",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "* **xgboostlss** — XGBoostLSS with a Dirichlet response distribution.  Tuning",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  uses the native :func:&#96;xgblss.hyper_opt&#96; Optuna interface.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "* **xgboost** — Standard :class:&#96;xgboost.XGBClassifier&#96;.  Tuning uses",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "  :mod:&#96;spotpy&#96; (SCE-UA, DE, SA, MC, ROPE, or random search).",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "For either backend a station-level :func:&#96;BMEcatPriorLOOCV&#96; cross-validation",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "function is provided to evaluate prediction accuracy before using the prior",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "inside :func:&#96;~stamps.bme.BMEcatPdf.BMEcatPdf&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "Bug fixes vs. the previous version",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "-----------------------------------",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "B1/B2  &#96;&#96;_prior_xgboost&#96;&#96; now accepts a 1-D integer &#96;&#96;ps_labels&#96;&#96; array",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "       directly (no &#96;&#96;shape[1]&#96;&#96; or &#96;&#96;argmax&#96;&#96;  crash).",
            "lineNumber": 25
